---
name: ✨ Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for Group Bluetooth Audio
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'needs-review']
assignees: ''
---

## ✨ Feature Summary
**A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.**

## 🤔 Problem/Use Case
**What problem would this feature solve? What's your use case?**
Example: "I often work with 3+ audio devices and need..."

## 💡 Proposed Solution
**Describe your ideal solution. How would this feature work?**

## 🎯 Feature Type
**What type of feature is this?**
- [ ] 🆓 Free feature (available to all users)
- [ ] 👑 Pro feature (requires Pro purchase)
- [ ] 🔧 Technical improvement
- [ ] 🎨 UI/UX enhancement
- [ ] 📱 New platform support

## 📱 Platform
**Which platform should this feature target?**
- [ ] macOS (current app)
- [ ] iOS companion app (future)
- [ ] Both platforms

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions
**Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.**

## 📸 Mockups/Examples
**If applicable, add mockups, sketches, or examples from other apps.**

## 📊 Priority
**How important is this feature to you?**
- [ ] 🔴 Critical - I can't use the app effectively without it
- [ ] 🟠 High - Would significantly improve my workflow
- [ ] 🟡 Medium - Nice to have, would use occasionally
- [ ] 🟢 Low - Minor improvement

## 👥 Community Impact
**Do you think other users would benefit from this feature?**
- [ ] Yes, most users would find this useful
- [ ] Yes, but only for specific use cases
- [ ] Unsure
- [ ] This is mainly for my specific needs

## 📋 Additional Context
**Add any other context, links, or examples about the feature request here.**

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] I have searched [existing issues](https://github.com/dcherrera/group-bluetooth-audio-website/issues) for similar requests
- [ ] I have checked if this might already be available as a Pro feature
- [ ] I understand that feature requests are prioritized based on community interest and technical feasibility
